description: INE infraestructura vial statistical tables provides official statistical tables on transport infrastructure lengths and facilities. The provider is Instituto Nacional de Estadistica, Bolivia. Geographical and temporal coverage: Bolivia's INE lists rail, river, airport, pipeline and other infrastructure tables with series extending to 2025. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is not stated in inspected metadata. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The landing page contains more than roads. Each table has its own units and dates; individual cells were not retrieved. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
